topic: Whether Azure GRS/GZRS copy data to the secondary region synchronously or asynchronously

readings.says: GRS and GZRS synchronously replicate data to a secondary region without requiring a replication configuration.
It then copies your data asynchronously to the secondary region.

handling: Notes cite the dedicated Azure Storage redundancy page (asynchronous) and do not repeat the comparison page's wording. Kept out of questions.

topic: How much lower S3 Express One Zone request costs are than S3 Standard

readings.says: S3 Express One Zone is the lowest latency cloud object storage class available today, with data access speeds up to 10x faster and with request costs 80 percent lower than S3 Standard.
S3 Express One Zone is the lowest latency cloud object storage class available today, with data access speed up to 10x faster and with request costs 50 percent lower than S3 Standard.

handling: Notes state no percentage for S3 Express One Zone request costs; the class is described only by the shared facts (single Availability Zone, lowest latency). Kept out of questions.

topic: Whether S3 Standard-IA and S3 One Zone-IA have a 30-day minimum storage duration

readings.says: If you delete an object before the end of the 30-day minimum storage duration period, you are charged for 30 days.
Amazon S3 no longer applies a 30-day minimum storage duration for transitions to Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access and Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access.

handling: Both readings are shown in the S3 storage classes comparison with their sources. They may describe different situations (deleting early versus transitioning), but no allowed page reconciles them, so the minimum-duration figure for the two infrequent-access classes is kept out of questions.

topic: How many public IP addresses an AWS NAT gateway can use

readings.says: AWS NAT gateways can be associated with only a single public IP. Azure NAT gateways can have multiple public IPs.
You can increase this limit by associating up to 8 IPv4 addresses to your NAT gateways (1 primary IPv4 address and 7 secondary IPv4 addresses).

handling: The AWS page is the authority for AWS behaviour. The notes show the Azure comparison row as written on Learn and the AWS reading beside it, and teach only the AWS statement. The single-IP claim is kept out of questions.
